items.title: Reactive lens: one reactive wrapper for any structure, the shape passed in as a handler - a bespoke structure (a rope) gets slots and fine-grained updates from one trait impl, and std's four cells become one lens plus two handlers (paper proposal/reactive-lens.md, DRAFT, Q1-Q10 open)
items.kind: design (std::reactive; the owner's proposal, from kolt's live prototype)
items.status: OPEN - filed 2026-11-05 (the owner's proposal; paper drafted by the integrator; unruled)
items.discussion: the owner, 2026-11-05: the current model needs a reactive twin per structure (ListCell, HashMapCell, HashSetCell, KeyedCell, Store) and an app's own structure gets none; state and reactivity need not be woven together. Ruled in discussion: a slot's get() answers Option<T>; a list and a set share insert/replace/delete and the lens takes the handler as a parameter. The integrator's review of the prototype (kolt/planning/proposal/live) found slot positions moving at the settle (a batched turn writes the wrong row) - law L2 of the paper
items.body: Paper: proposal/reactive-lens.md. Probe: proposal/reactive-lens-probe/src/probe.vl (0.54.0, JS backend; one Lens type over a list, a toy rope and a HashSet; the batched-turn case passes). Reopens reactive-layers.md §6 (once per SHAPE, not once per type) and store.md Q11 (a positional handle becomes sound). Depends on B711 S1 for field edits (S5 only). Five acceptance tests gate any change to std's own cells (paper §9); S1 and S2 are additive. Related: B711, M199 + M193 (the copies the lens's in-place lend avoids), A142, A112, A138. Sizing L (seven slices); next step is the owner's rulings on Q1-Q10.
